questions.question: What did David do that brought judgment, against God's will?
options: Took a census of the fighting men
Made a treaty with a pagan nation
Built an altar on a forbidden hill
questions.answer: Took a census of the fighting men

questions.question: How did the plague that followed come to an end?
options: The prophet Gad offered sacrifices on Mount Zion
David numbered the people a second time in sorrow
David gave half his treasure to the temple priests
David built an altar at the threshing floor of Araunah
questions.answer: David built an altar at the threshing floor of Araunah

questions.question: David chose to fall into the hands of the LORD rather than his enemies.
David sinned by numbering (taking a _____ of) the people of Israel.
David built an altar at the threshing floor of _____ to stop the plague.
